about.title: Method and scope
about.subtitle: The desktop shell wraps the experiment inference path without changing preprocessing, model structure, or ensemble rules.
about.pipeline: DCE-MRI and MLO images are concatenated with their decay1 spatial priors, normalized and resampled by the original experiment code. CP.xlsx is encoded into 32 clinical and 23 pathology features. Two ResNet18 backbones and two MLPs map the four inputs to 256-dimensional tokens; a CLS Transformer fuses them into two-class logits.
about.ensemble: Ten checkpoints are loaded: five folds × AUC / ACC selection metrics. Per-class softmax probabilities are arithmetically averaged, and the higher mean probability gives the ensemble class.
about.research_only: Research use only. Not for clinical diagnosis, treatment decisions, or medical advice. The experiment package does not specify a clinical threshold, calibration method, or prospective validation results.
about.fidelity_value: Original Dataset and network definitions reused item by item
about.guide_body: Follow the six stages below. Preprocessing is always explicit; inference only consumes the four model-ready inputs.
about.step1_body: Use one study root with CP.xlsx and MRMG/. Place each case under MRMG/<disk label>/<CaseID>/ with DCE, MLO, and paired GTV/GTVnd1 contours.
about.step2_body: Open Preprocessing, scan the root, then generate N4-corrected DCE and both decay1 masks. A derived CP_prepared.xlsx fills only the lowest-layer ALN diameter when it is empty.
about.step3_body: The four required products are <CaseID>_DCE_N4, <CaseID>_DCE_decay1, MG/<CaseID>_MLO, and MG/<CaseID>_MLO_decay1. Existing products are used unchanged.
about.step4_body: The original experiment maps CP.xlsx to 32 clinical and 23 pathology features. Z-score means and standard deviations, category order, and missing-value handling remain unchanged.
about.step5_body: DCE and MLO are z-score normalized and resized to 144×320×320 and 640×512. Each image is concatenated with its decay mask; two ResNet18 backbones and two MLPs create four 256-dimensional tokens for the CLS Transformer.
about.step6_body: Ten checkpoints (5 folds × AUC/ACC) each produce softmax probabilities. The arithmetic mean determines the class. Review the six-decimal probability, checkpoint vote split, and distance from 0.5.

disclaimer.section4_body: The developers make no express or implied warranty regarding accuracy, completeness, timeliness, or fitness for a particular purpose. Model knowledge may be outdated, incomplete, or inapplicable. All risk from research interpretation remains with the user.
disclaimer.section5_body: Use does not create a physician-patient relationship. This desktop build performs local inference and does not contact the developers. The developers are not liable for decisions or actions based on its outputs.

about.structure: Select a study root containing CP.xlsx and MRMG/. Each case folder may contain a DCE_N4 or raw DCE image, paired DCE GTV/GTVnd1 contours, an MLO image, and paired MLO GTV/GTVnd1 contours. Existing DCE_N4 files are used byte-for-byte; both decay1 masks and any missing N4 image are generated by the workbench.
